assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls (FAR, building height, density, green ratio, setbacks) are not available in the public site package. All intensity and height recommendations are conceptual design proposals pending official regulatory planning conditions.
assumptions.impact: Building scale, development intensity, and height controls cannot be formally verified until official regulatory conditions are published.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key area polygons are derived from official announcement text descriptions and approximate area values. These are provisional rough boundaries, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area calculations, land use partitions, and spatial metrics must be recalculated when official GIS/CAD boundaries become available.

assumptions.statement: Land ownership, existing building conditions, and demolition/retention decisions require field survey and professional assessment. Current retain/renovate/demolish classifications are conceptual only.
assumptions.impact: Implementation phasing and project lists are directional proposals, not confirmed construction plans.

assumptions.statement: Municipal infrastructure capacity (water, sewage, power, gas, telecom), fire access, and drainage conditions are not available in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure recommendations are strategic directions; engineering feasibility requires professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, rail station integration parameters, and traffic impact assessments require official traffic planning data.
assumptions.impact: Traffic and slow-traffic proposals are conceptual frameworks; detailed design requires professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection zones, controlled excavation areas, and cultural relic buffer zones along the railway alignment require official heritage authority confirmation.
assumptions.impact: Design proposals near heritage sites are directional; final design must comply with heritage protection requirements.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenarios follow data minimization, informed consent, human review, and public transparency principles. No personal behavior tracking or unauthorized profiling.
assumptions.impact: AI scenario designs are conceptual frameworks for professional teams to deepen with proper data governance.

assumptions.statement: Annual activity systems, developer community operations, and international promotion mechanisms are conceptual proposals, not confirmed government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: Operational plans require professional team confirmation, funding mechanisms, and government approval.
